## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and affected platforms.

## Verification

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked --all-targets`
- [ ] Relevant GUI or packaging check, if applicable
- [ ] English and Russian docs updated, if behavior changed

## Review notes

Mention format migrations, file-save risks, or platform gaps. Do not include private documents or credentials.
